name: Kerpen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, red and yellow in the proportions 1:4:1, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Kerpen (a red lion on white and a castle on yellow).
history: As a hoisted flag: gold (yellow), red and gold (yellow) in the ratio 1:4:1 striped, with the shield of arms shifted towards the staff; the banner carries the same stripes lengthwise.
